snippet.title: Crazy Taxi: World Tour - Welcome to Japan
snippet.description:
Japan: A place beautifully suspended between two worlds. Here, historic neighborhoods and tradition sit alongside the bustling energy of the modern city. Get ready to fall in love with the land of the rising sun when Crazy Taxi: World Tour hits the streets in 2027!
